case_number: 2024 INSC 328; CIVIL APPEAL No. 4422/2024 (ARISING OUT OF SLP (C) No. 14475/2021)
summary: Promotional trailer ('promo') not contractual offer; no implied promise of song inclusion; entertainment service deficiency analysis; unfair trade practice requires deception; standard: reasonable consumer expectation; commercial speech protections; artistic expression in advertising; trailer creates buzz, not enforceable obligations; consumer court jurisdiction limits; impugned NCDRC order set aside; no deficiency or unfair practice found.
legal_provisions_cited: Consumer Protection Act, 1986 s.2(1)(d), s.2(1)(c), s.2(1)(o)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; NCDRC and State Commission orders set aside; compensation award reversed.
